command_result.command: cd /app && git status 2>&1 | head -3; find . -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -100; cat docs/BUILDING.md; cat VERSION configure.ac; cat Makefile.am isodur.pc.in

cd /app && for f in lib/Makefile.am src/Makefile.am tests/Makefile.am data/Makefile.am include/isodur/version.h.in tests/cli.test lib/version.c lib/internal.h; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done; cat docs/consuming.md; grep -n 'include\|ISODUR_DATADIR\|config.h' src/main.c lib/*.c tests/unit.c | head -50; ls -a; cat CHANGELOG.md | head -20

cd /app && cat src/main.c; grep -n 'data\|getenv\|argv' tests/unit.c | head -20; cat include/isodur/isodur.h | grep -n 'isodur_\|include' | head -50; cat docs/isodur.md; which autoreconf pkgconf pkg-config

cd /app && cat > Makefile.am <<'EOF'
ACLOCAL_AMFLAGS = -I m4

if BUILD_TOOL
TOOL_DIR = src
endif
SUBDIRS = lib $(TOOL_DIR) data tests

isodurincludedir = $(includedir)/isodur
isodurinclude_HEADERS = include/isodur/isodur.h
nodist_isodurinclude_HEADERS = include/isodur/version.h

pkgconfigdir = $(libdir)/pkgconfig
pkgconfig_DATA = isodur.pc

CONFIGURE_DEPENDENCIES = $(top_srcdir)/VERSION
EXTRA_DIST = CHANGELOG.md docs VERSION include/isodur/version.h.in isodur.pc.in
EOF
cat > lib/Makefile.am <<'EOF'
AM_CPPFLAGS = -I$(top_srcdir)/include -I$(top_builddir)/include

lib_LTLIBRARIES = libisodur.la
libisodur_la_SOURCES = \
	arith.c \
	format.c \
	parse.c \
	units.c \
	version.c \
	internal.h
libisodur_la_LIBADD = $(LIBM)
libisodur_la_LDFLAGS = -version-info @ISODUR_LT_VERSION@ \
	-export-symbols-regex '^isodur_[A-Za-z]'
EOF
cat > src/Makefile.am <<'EOF'
AM_CPPFLAGS = -I$(top_srcdir)/include -I$(top_builddir)/include -I$(top_builddir) \
	-DISODUR_DATADIR='"$(pkgdatadir)"'

bin_PROGRAMS = isodur
isodur_SOURCES = main.c
isodur_LDADD = $(top_builddir)/lib/libisodur.la

# durfmt, the 1.x name of the program (docs/BUILDING.md 6).
install-exec-hook:
	cd "$(DESTDIR)$(bindir)" && rm -f durfmt$(EXEEXT) && $(LN_S) isodur$(EXEEXT) durfmt$(EXEEXT)

uninstall-hook:
	rm -f "$(DESTDIR)$(bindir)/durfmt$(EXEEXT)"
EOF
cat > tests/Makefile.am <<'EOF'
AM_CPPFLAGS = -I$(top_srcdir)/include -I$(top_builddir)/include

check_PROGRAMS = unit
unit_SOURCES = unit.c
unit_LDADD = $(top_builddir)/lib/libisodur.la

TESTS = unit
if BUILD_TOOL
TESTS += cli.test
endif

TEST_EXTENSIONS = .test
TEST_LOG_COMPILER = $(SHELL)
AM_TESTS_ENVIRONMENT = \
	ISODUR='$(abs_top_builddir)/src/isodur'; \
	DATA='$(abs_top_srcdir)/data'; \
	CASES='$(abs_srcdir)/cases'; \
	export ISODUR DATA CASES;

EXTRA_DIST = cli.test cases
EOF
cat > isodur.pc.in <<'EOF'
prefix=@prefix@
exec_prefix=@exec_prefix@
libdir=@libdir@
includedir=@includedir@
datarootdir=@datarootdir@
datadir=@datadir@
pkgdatadir=${datadir}/@PACKAGE@

Name: isodur
Description: ISO 8601 duration parsing and formatting
Version: @PACKAGE_VERSION@
Libs: -L${libdir} -lisodur
Libs.private: @LIBM@
Cflags: -I${includedir}
EOF
mkdir -p m4; rm -rf /tmp/b && mkdir /tmp/b && autoreconf -fi 2>&1 | tail -20; ls m4

cd /app && rm -rf autom4te.cache build-aux m4/*.m4 aclocal.m4 configure config.h.in* Makefile.in */Makefile.in; ls -a . m4; rm -rf /tmp/t && cp -a /app /tmp/t && rmdir /tmp/t/m4 && cd /tmp/t && autoreconf -fi 2>&1 | grep -i 'warn\|error'; mkdir /tmp/t/_b && cd /tmp/t/_b && ../configure --prefix=/opt/x >/dev/null && make 2>&1 | grep -i 'warn\|error'; make check 2>&1 | grep -E '^(# |PASS|FAIL)'; make install DESTDIR=/tmp/inst >/dev/null && find /tmp/inst | sort; cat /tmp/inst/opt/x/lib/pkgconfig/isodur.pc

cd /app && echo 'Project macros go here; libtoolize copies the libtool macros into this directory.' > m4/README; cd /tmp/t/_b && make install DESTDIR=/tmp/inst 2>&1 | tail -5; find /tmp/inst | sort; cat /tmp/inst/opt/x/lib/pkgconfig/isodur.pc

cd /tmp/t/_b && ls -l /tmp/inst/opt/x/bin; nm -D --defined-only /tmp/inst/opt/x/lib/libisodur.so | grep ' T '; readelf -d /tmp/inst/opt/x/lib/libisodur.so | grep -i 'soname\|needed'; grep -rl /tmp/inst /tmp/inst; strings /tmp/inst/opt/x/bin/isodur | grep share; make uninstall DESTDIR=/tmp/inst >/dev/null 2>&1; find /tmp/inst ! -type d; cd /tmp/t && make -C _b distcheck 2>&1 | tail -5

cd /app && printf 'pkgdata_DATA = units.tsv\nEXTRA_DIST = $(pkgdata_DATA)\n' > data/Makefile.am && cat data/Makefile.am; rm -rf /tmp/t && cp -a /app /tmp/t && cd /tmp/t && autoreconf -fi 2>&1 | grep -i 'warn\|error'; mkdir _b && cd _b && ../configure --prefix=/opt/x >/dev/null && make distcheck > /tmp/dc.log 2>&1; echo rc=$?; tail -4 /tmp/dc.log

cd /tmp/t/_b && tar tzf isodur-1.4.0.tar.gz | grep -v '^isodur-1.4.0/\(tests/cases\|docs\)' ; rm -rf /tmp/u && mkdir /tmp/u && tar xzf isodur-1.4.0.tar.gz -C /tmp/u && cd /tmp/u/isodur-1.4.0 && autoreconf -fi 2>&1 | grep -i 'warn|error'; mkdir _b && cd _b && ../configure >/dev/null && make >/dev/null 2>&1 && make check 2>&1 | grep -E '^# (PASS|FAIL)'
